title: Grape and Herb Chutney
description: A sweet and tangy Indian-inspired chutney made with fresh grapes and herbs. Serve as a side dish or use as a topping for naan bread or grilled meats.
instructions: In a pan, heat 1 tbsp of water over medium heat.
Add the grapes, herbs, and leaves to the pan and stir to combine.
Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the grapes have broken down and the mixture has thickened.
Stir in the with and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
